test: the home page says "Deccan Sports Complex · the planner" over the heading "Four grounds." / "No pencil on the wall."
what_should_happen: Above the big heading the home page says "Deccan Sports Complex · the planner". The heading reads "Four grounds." with "No pencil on the wall." on the next line.

test: once the numbers are in, the counts read 4 grounds, 6 event types and 1 held next Saturday on A
what_should_happen: The row of counts shows how many grounds and event types the planner has, and how many bookings hold Ground A next Saturday. With one booking on Ground A next Saturday, once everything has arrived it reads 4 grounds, 6 event types and 1 held next Saturday on A.

test: with nothing booked, once Ground A's day is in, held next Saturday on A is 0
what_should_happen: When nobody has booked anything yet, the count of bookings held next Saturday on Ground A is 0. It still says 0 after Ground A's day has arrived.

test: two bookings on Ground A next Saturday, one of them cancelled, count as 1 held
what_should_happen: Ground A has two bookings next Saturday and one of them has been cancelled. A cancelled booking holds nothing, so the count reads 1 held next Saturday on A.

test: before the numbers arrive the counts already read 4, 6 and 0, and the picture comes once the day is in
what_should_happen: The moment the page first draws, before any numbers have arrived, the counts already show 4, 6 and 0 in their places. The small picture of Ground A's day is not there yet. It appears, with its booking, once the day has arrived.

test: the picture shows Ground A's hours and a block with each booking's number
what_should_happen: Beside the heading a small picture of Ground A's next Saturday shows the ground's hours. Each booking that day is a block carrying its booking number, such as BK0001 and BK0002.

test: the picture is only a picture: nothing in it is a button or a link, and clicking a block does nothing
what_should_happen: The picture of the day is decoration only. Nothing in it is a button or a link, and clicking a booking's block leaves you on the home page with nothing opened.

test: under "Who are you today?" there is one card each for Sabu, Deepa and Anita
what_should_happen: Under the heading "Who are you today?" and its line about each person's screens there are exactly three cards. Each card has the person's initial, name, role, a line about what they do and "Continue as" with their name: Sabu the caretaker, Deepa the booking clerk and Anita the municipal officer.
exact_words: Each person sees their own screens. Everything they do changes the same planner.
Looks after the four grounds. Reads each ground’s day: the bookings and the setup and teardown around them.
Takes the clubs’ calls. Requests slots, confirms them, cancels them and moves them.
Answers for the complex. Reads every booking’s record.

reason: The colour of each person's initial circle can only be seen in a real browser.

test: clicking Sabu's card opens The day at /caretaker/day
what_should_happen: Clicking Sabu's card on the home page opens his screen, The day. The address becomes /caretaker/day.

test: clicking Deepa's card opens Book at /clerk/book
what_should_happen: Clicking Deepa's card opens her first screen, Book. The address becomes /clerk/book.

test: clicking Anita's card opens Records at /officer/records
what_should_happen: Clicking Anita's card opens her screen, Records. The address becomes /officer/records.

test: Tab reaches each card, and Enter on Anita's card opens /officer/records
what_should_happen: Without a mouse, pressing Tab moves through the page and reaches Sabu's, Deepa's and Anita's cards in turn. Pressing Enter on Anita's card opens /officer/records.

test: Enter on Sabu's card, reached with Tab, opens /caretaker/day
what_should_happen: Pressing Tab until Sabu's card is outlined and then Enter opens his first screen. The address becomes /caretaker/day.

reason: Where the picture sits, the cards stacking and the page not scrolling sideways at phone width need a real browser's layout.

test: on the home page the header has the GroundBook logo with "Deccan Sports Complex" and no back arrow or person menu
what_should_happen: On the home page the header shows the GroundBook logo, which links home, with "Deccan Sports Complex" under the name. There is no back arrow and no person menu, because the home page belongs to nobody.

test: on Deepa's Book the back arrow sits before the logo and the person menu shows D, Deepa and Booking clerk
what_should_happen: On Deepa's Book a back arrow named "Back to the home page" comes before the logo in the header. On the right the person menu shows her initial D, "Deepa" and "Booking clerk".

reason: The colour of the person's initial circle can only be seen in a real browser.

test: on Sabu's and Anita's screens the person menu shows their own initial, name and role
what_should_happen: On Sabu's The day and on Anita's Records the header has the back arrow too. Its person menu shows S, "Sabu" and "Caretaker" for Sabu, and A, "Anita" and "Municipal officer" for Anita.

test: the back arrow on a person's screen opens the home page
what_should_happen: On Deepa's Book, clicking the back arrow opens the home page. The address becomes /.

test: the logo on a person's screen opens the home page
what_should_happen: On Sabu's The day, clicking the GroundBook logo opens the home page. The address becomes /.

test: clicking the person menu opens "View the planner as" with Sabu, Deepa and Anita and their roles
what_should_happen: Clicking the closed person menu opens a list headed "View the planner as". It has exactly three people, in this order: Sabu (Caretaker), Deepa (Booking clerk) and Anita (Municipal officer).

reason: The tick beside the current person is a drawing that screen readers skip, so only a real browser shows it.

test: in the open list the ticked person, Deepa on her own Book, is read as the current one, and only her
what_should_happen: The tick beside the current person is a drawing, so a screen reader is told in another way who is current. With Deepa's list open on her Book, Deepa is read as the current one, and Sabu and Anita are not.

test: picking Anita on Deepa's Book closes the list, opens /officer/records and shows Anita in the header
what_should_happen: With the list open on Deepa's Book, picking Anita closes the list. Records opens at /officer/records and the person menu now shows Anita, the municipal officer, instead of Deepa.

test: picking Sabu opens The day at /caretaker/day
what_should_happen: With the list open, picking Sabu closes it and opens The day. The address becomes /caretaker/day and the header shows Sabu.

test: a click outside the list closes it and you stay where you were
what_should_happen: With the list open, clicking anywhere outside it closes the list. The page stays on Deepa's Book and the header still shows Deepa.

test: Esc closes the list and you stay where you were
what_should_happen: With the list open, pressing Esc closes it. The page stays on Deepa's Book and the header still shows Deepa.

test: on Deepa's Book the tabs Book and Bookings sit in the title row, and Book is the one she is on
what_should_happen: Deepa's title row has two tabs, "Book" and "Bookings", together named as Deepa's screens. On Book, the Book tab is marked as the screen she is on and the Bookings tab is not.

reason: That the current tab is filled with Deepa's colour can only be seen in a real browser.

test: clicking the Bookings tab opens /clerk/bookings and Bookings is now the one she is on
what_should_happen: On Book, clicking the "Bookings" tab opens Bookings at /clerk/bookings. Now the Bookings tab is the one marked as current, and Book is not.

test: Sabu's The day and Anita's Records have no tabs
what_should_happen: Sabu and Anita each have only one screen. On The day and on Records there are no tabs, and no Book or Bookings link.

test: the address /clerk opens Book and becomes /clerk/book
what_should_happen: Opening the short address /clerk takes Deepa straight to Book. The address becomes /clerk/book and the Book tab is the current one.

test: /caretaker becomes /caretaker/day and /officer becomes /officer/records
what_should_happen: Opening /caretaker shows Sabu's The day at /caretaker/day. Opening /officer shows Anita's Records at /officer/records.

what_should_happen: Opening an address the planner does not have, such as /pitch, opens the home page instead. The address becomes / and the header has no back arrow.

what_should_happen: Without a mouse, Tab on Deepa's Book reaches the back arrow first, then the logo, then the person menu. Enter on the person menu opens the list "View the planner as".

test: in the open menu Tab reaches each person, and Enter on Anita opens Records
what_should_happen: With the list open, Tab reaches Sabu, Deepa and Anita in turn, because each person is a button. Enter on Anita opens Records at /officer/records.

test: Esc closes the menu and puts the focus back on the person menu
what_should_happen: With the list open and the focus on Sabu, pressing Esc closes the list. The focus goes back to the person menu, so the keyboard carries on from there.
